title: 一瓶垃圾挑战
paragraphs: April 22nd is World Earth Day—a day to remind people to protect the earth. On that day this year, our family held an activity “Bottle of Trash Challenge”. That means the trash needs to be put in a 600-milliliter bottle. We made the decision to challenge ourselves and produce as little trash as possible.
My father worked online all day, so he didn’t produce any waste except paper napkins. He made the least trash in our family.

My mother cooked dinner and produced plenty of kitchen waste, such as vegetable leaves, eggshells and food bags. What’s worse, she had to deal with all the leftovers we made after dinner. Luckily, she found a way to put it all into the bottle. How amazing!

My sister, a 16-year-old student, was busy preparing for her exams. She had to use paper to work out math and physics problems. She used only one side of the paper in the past. But that day, she tried to use both sides of the paper because she realized she could challenge herself in that way. She did a good job!

I was different from my sister. As a boy, I love snacks and drinks. So my trash was almost from them. I was highly alert that I must produce less waste. I hardly had snacks or drinks that day. It was too difficult, but I did it!
I learnt a lot from this activity. I realized that everyone can produce less trash. We should start with small actions to protect the earth!

questions.stem: What did the writer’s family do on April 22nd this year?
questions.reason: 选A：They organized an activity。首段说全家在4月22日举行“Bottle of Trash Challenge”，并说明要把垃圾控制在一个瓶子内。held an activity与organized an activity同义；旅行、野餐、派对均不是这次活动的内容。

questions.stem: On that day, who made the least trash?
questions.reason: 选B：The writer's father。第二段直接说“He made the least trash in our family”，he指全天在线工作的父亲，除纸巾外未产生其他垃圾。题目问最少垃圾的家庭成员，不是最积极挑战自己或最难减少垃圾的人。

questions.stem: The underlined word “leftovers” in Paragraph 3 means ____.
options: food bags that are used to put the vegetable leaves
food that hasn’t been eaten at the end of a meal
waste that is produced in the kitchen
dishes that are cooked by the writer’s mother
questions.reason: 选B：food that hasn't been eaten at the end of a meal。leftovers出现在after dinner需要处理的语境中，指吃剩的饭菜。C的所有厨余范围过宽，还包括蛋壳、菜叶等；A的包装袋和D的全部菜肴也不等于剩饭菜。

questions.stem: What was the writer’s sister busy doing?
questions.reason: 选C：Preparing for her exams。第四段直接说明姐姐was busy preparing for her exams，后面算数学、物理题解释了她为何用纸。做晚饭的是母亲，在线工作的是父亲；作答要把活动与对应家庭成员配对。

questions.stem: According to the passage, which of the following is TRUE?
options: The writer’s sister had less snacks and drinks.
The writer himself used both sides of the paper.
The writer’s father ate up all the food of the dinner.
The writer’s mother dealt with all the leftovers herself.
questions.reason: 选D：The writer's mother dealt with all the leftovers herself。第三段明确母亲处理了饭后所有剩饭菜。A把作者少吃零食喝饮料的行动移给姐姐；B把姐姐双面用纸的行动移给作者；C所说父亲吃光饭菜也无依据。
